text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian topples the Emperor and claims the Japan Cup. In that moment, a new legend is born…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching from the stands, Mayano Top Gun is moved by Narita Brian's performance and is filled with a desire to race her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having surpassed her personal summit, Narita Brian shows no signs of slowing down as she eagerly anticipates her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though many call her the Emperor's successor, she can only follow her own road. And next stop on that road is the Arima Kinen, the final race of the Senior Autumn Triple Crown!
